description: Record an assumption you are acting on — something you treat as true but have not verified (e.g. "staging tests passed", "no active legal hold on this record"). Attach it to the action whose decision rests on it so operators can later validate or refute it and staleness drift is tracked. Call right after the action that depends on the belief.

action_id.description: Parent action id the assumption underpins (from dashclaw_record)

assumption.description: The belief being treated as true

name: dashclaw_assumption_record
